login.heading: Log in
login.hint: Dev login: any email works when the backend runs with DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true.
login.failed: Login failed — is the backend up?

home.heading: It works
home.body: This is the post-init shell: typed API client, auth, routing, tests, OTA updates. Add your first feature under src/features/ and route it from app/(app)/.

error.heading: Something went wrong
error.sessionExpired: Your session expired — log in again.

consent.prompt: Send crash reports and performance data to help improve the app?
consent.heading: Usage data
consent.body: Crash reports and performance data, linked to your account id. Never your email.
